cues: Notice what happens as the temperature gap grows.
A chiller, keeping drinks just below room temperature, is cheap to run.
A deep freezer, pumping heat across a big gap, costs far more.
text: Notice what happens as the temperature gap grows. The coefficient falls steeply. A chiller, keeping drinks just below room temperature, is cheap to run. A deep freezer, pumping heat across a big gap, costs far more.
